decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds directly on the firm's machining and automation know-how, so it can interpret early feedback and refine the product through in-house development, which fits its strategic push toward smarter automation.

The dual-table loading system is a close extension of the established machine offer, where existing application knowledge and service infrastructure let the firm absorb market learning and improve it at low risk.

Although dispensing is further from the core, the firm already has a dispensing line and in-house development, and the Red Dot award and dedicated page signal commitment, so it has enough related knowledge to keep learning and improving the product rather than dropping it after one year.
